object.attr: analysis: a file without the ending doesn't open as a PDF, and the MCP tool refuses such a name (MELLON-PDF-SRS-26). Decided on 2026-11-11 (review Q29). Confirm against 0.3.0; set Implemented if 0.3.0 does this (review Q46).
object.description: If the file name chosen in the save dialog doesn't end in .pdf, compared without regard to letter case, the Document Editor shall add .pdf to the output path.
